principals.name: Client
principals.description: TLS initiator: initially holds its identity, trust configuration, optional PSK state and certificate signing credential, negotiation policies, and outbound application data; it generates fresh hello/key-share values, computes binders, MACs and derived traffic keys, verifies the server signature and Finished, and encrypts/decrypts records.

principals.name: Server
principals.description: TLS responder: initially holds its identity, trust configuration, optional PSK/ticket state and certificate signing credential, negotiation and authentication policies, and outbound application data; it selects parameters, generates fresh hello/key-share values, signs CertificateVerify, verifies client authentication and Finished, derives traffic keys, and encrypts/decrypts records.

values.name: sk_Client
values.description: The client's long-term private signature key for certificate-based client authentication.

values.name: pk_Client
values.description: The client's public signature-verification key, computed from sk_Client and carried in its certificate; the server receives the certificate in the Certificate message and validates it against its trust anchors.

values.name: sk_Server
values.description: The server's long-term private signature key for certificate-based authentication.

values.name: pk_Server
values.description: The server's public signature-verification key, computed from sk_Server and carried in its certificate; the client receives the certificate in the Certificate message and validates it against its trust anchors.

values.name: Client
values.description: The client's own identity, bound to its certificate; the server learns it from the client's Certificate message.

values.name: Server
values.description: The server's own identity; the client's configured knowledge of the server is server_name.

values.name: PSK
values.description: A pre-shared key provisioned out of band to client and server. A PSK established by a previous handshake (resumption) is not this value but comes out of the flow.

values.name: identity
values.description: The PSK identity, which must be provisioned together with an out-of-band PSK.

values.name: PSK_KDF_identifier
values.description: The KDF (hash) to be used with the out-of-band PSK, which must be provisioned together with it.

values.name: PSK_cipher_suite
values.description: The cipher suite for use with an externally obtained PSK for early data, provisioned to both parties.

values.name: server_name
values.description: The server's name: the server's own, and the name the client is configured to connect to and checks against the server certificate.

values.name: ALPN_protocol
values.description: The ALPN protocol for use with an externally obtained PSK for early data, provisioned to both parties if one is used.

values.name: supported_versions_Client
values.description: The protocol versions the client supports.

values.name: supported_versions_Server
values.description: The protocol versions the server supports.

values.name: cipher_suites_Client
values.description: The cipher suites the client supports, in preference order.

values.name: cipher_suites_Server
values.description: The cipher suites the server supports.

values.name: supported_groups_Client
values.description: The key exchange groups the client supports, in preference order.

values.name: supported_groups_Server
values.description: The key exchange groups the server supports.

values.name: signature_algorithms_Client
values.description: The signature algorithms the client supports.

values.name: signature_algorithms_Server
values.description: The signature algorithms the server supports.

values.name: psk_key_exchange_modes_Client
values.description: The PSK key exchange modes the client supports.

values.name: psk_key_exchange_modes_Server
values.description: The PSK key exchange modes the server accepts.

values.name: ALPN_protocols_Client
values.description: The ALPN protocols the client supports.

values.name: ALPN_protocols_Server
values.description: The ALPN protocols the server supports.

values.name: certificate_list_Client
values.description: The client's own certificate chain.

values.name: certificate_list_Server
values.description: The server's own certificate chain.

values.name: trust_anchor_Client
values.description: The client's trust anchors (trusted CA certificates) for validating the server's certificate.

values.name: trust_anchor_Server
values.description: The server's trust anchors (trusted CA certificates) for validating the client's certificate.

values.name: certificate_authorities_Client
values.description: The list of certificate authorities the client accepts, sent in its certificate_authorities extension.

values.name: certificate_authorities_Server
values.description: The list of certificate authorities the server accepts for client certificates, sent in CertificateRequest.

values.name: oid_filters_Server
values.description: The server's certificate extension OID filters for client certificates, sent in CertificateRequest.

values.name: client_authentication_policy_Server
values.description: The server's local policy on whether and how to request client authentication.

values.name: post_handshake_auth_policy_Client
values.description: The client's local policy on whether it offers post-handshake authentication.

values.name: early_data_policy_Client
values.description: The client's local policy on whether to send 0-RTT data.

values.name: early_data_policy_Server
values.description: The server's local policy on whether to accept 0-RTT data.

values.name: ticket_lifetime
values.description: The ticket lifetime the server sets in NewSessionTicket (at most 7 days); the client receives it there.

values.name: max_early_data_size
values.description: The maximum amount of 0-RTT data the server allows per ticket, sent in the early_data extension of NewSessionTicket; the client receives it there.

values.name: cookie_integrity_key_Server
values.description: The server's own key for integrity-protecting the HelloRetryRequest cookie.

values.name: ticket_protection_key_Server
values.description: The server's own key for protecting self-encrypted session tickets.
